title: ai features cheat sheet / Use agents
content: ## Use agents Use the [{% data variables.copilot.chat_view %}](/docs/agents/run/chat-view.md) to work beside your code, or the **{% data variables.copilot.agents_window %}** to focus on assigning higher-level tasks and reviewing outcomes. For a complex change, **plan**, **implement**, **verify**, then **review**: * **Plan:** Ask the Plan agent to research the change and identify risks. Review the approach before handing it to an implementation agent. * **Implement:** Describe the intended behavior and constraints. The agent searches your code, edits files, and uses tools. * **Verify:** Ask the agent to run relevant tests or exercise the app. Inspect what it actually checked. * **Review:** Review the diff and validation results before committing or merging. For example, give the agent a concrete browser check: ```prompt Open the app and test the sign-up flow with a missing email address. Verify that it shows a validation error and does not submit the form. Report what you tested and any problems you found. ``` To organize larger tasks: * Use [separate sessions and worktrees](/docs/agents/guides/delegate-two-tasks.md) for independent tasks that should not share code changes. * Use [subagents](/docs/agents/run/subagents.md) to delegate a focused part of a task in a separate context. * [Hand off a session](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#continue-with-a-different-harness) when you want to continue work with another supported harness. For cloud execution, [start a cloud session](/docs/agents/run/cloud-sandbox-sessions.md).
